purpose: Define the generic node graph editor for canonical relations, schemas, Events, Triggers, Commands, runners and Meta wiring using typed ports and explicit validated edges.

topics.name: Node Graph Editor
topics.purpose: Define the generic node graph editor for canonical relations, schemas, Events, Triggers, Commands, runners and Meta wiring using typed ports and explicit validated edges.

semantics.node_rule: Each graph node references an exact canonical semantic identity or declared content-only node type.
semantics.port_rule: Nodes may expose any number of typed input/output ports.
semantics.edge_rule: Connections are explicit edges and validate source/target port compatibility before apply.
semantics.semantic_rule: Graph adjacency/position does not create semantic relation without explicit edge identity/type.
semantics.scope_rule: Graph may project relations, schemas, Events, Triggers, Commands, runners and other Meta wiring according to supported node types.
semantics.layout_rule: Node coordinates, zoom and visual clustering are presentation state only.
semantics.authority_rule: Graph edit applies through normal canonical operations and AC checks.

invariants.rule: Editor surfaces project and mutate canonical semantics only through explicit validated operations; editor layout or widget state never becomes semantic or runtime authority.

hard_gates.condition: graph node identity inferred only from label
graph edit bypasses normal operation/authority path

references.purpose: Node Graph uses shared apply/validation pipeline.
Semantic edges use canonical relation semantics where applicable.
